dictionary.definition: iron; strong, solid, firm

currentComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 铁 refers to iron, a metal
失 (shī) gives a sound distantly related to 铁's reading tiě, having drifted apart over time

dictionary.definition: to ask about, to inquire into; to consult

usedInWords.meaning: variant of 諮詢|咨询[zi1 xun2]

currentComponents.note: 讠 (speech) shows 询 relates to asking or speaking.
旬 (xún) gives the exact sound of 询.

dictionary.definition: to fuse, to melt; to market, to sell

currentComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 销 originally meant to melt metal.
肖 (xiào) gives a rhyme close to xiāo, with the tone shifted.

dictionary.definition: to sell

etymology.hint: A street vendor talks 口 incessantly, like a bird 隹

currentComponents.note: 隹 (bird) suggests constant chatter, like a bird calling.
口 (mouth) below pictures a vendor calling out to sell goods, giving 售 its meaning 'to sell.'

dictionary.definition: to measure, to weigh; to consider, to judge

etymology.hint: A big 大 horn 角; 行 provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 角 (a horn) — a fixed point on a balance beam.
大 (big) — the wide crossbar of a scale itself, together giving 衡 its meaning 'to weigh, to measure, balance.'

dictionary.definition: shark

currentComponents.note: 鱼 (fish) — 鲨 names sharks.
沙 (shā) gives the sound — an exact match with 鲨's reading.

dictionary.definition: fish

currentComponents.note: 鱼 is a simplified picture of a fish — the top traces its head and fins, and the strokes below represent its body and tail.

dictionary.definition: to kiss; lips; coinciding

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — kissing is done with the mouth.
勿 (wù) gives a sound distantly related to wěn, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: ride, mount; to make use of; to ascend; to multiply

etymology.hint: Two feet 北 climbing a beanstalk 禾

currentComponents.note: 北 here representing two feet or footprints, one behind the other.
禾 (a stalk of grain), here standing in for a tree or ladder — together depicting someone climbing up, giving 乘 its meaning 'to ride, to get onto.'

dictionary.definition: group, crowd; multitude, mob

currentComponents.note: 羊 (sheep) — 群 relates to a group or flock, as sheep gather in a flock
君 (jūn) gives a loose sound connection to 群's reading qún

dictionary.definition: the female principle; dark, shaded; hidden, implicit, secret

etymology.hint: The place 阝 of the moon 月; compare 阳

currentComponents.note: 阝 (a mound, a place) — 阴 relates to the shaded side of a hill.
月 (moon) — the moon, associated with night and shade, gave 阴 its meaning 'shady, overcast'; compare 阳, which uses 日 (sun) for the opposite, sunny meaning.

dictionary.definition: throat, larynx, gullet; guttural

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 喉 names a part of the mouth and throat area.
侯 (hóu) gives the sound — an exact match with 喉.

dictionary.definition: throat

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 咙 (as in 喉咙) names the throat, an opening in the body.
龙 (lóng) gives the sound — an exact match with 咙's reading.

dictionary.definition: two, both, pair, couple; ounce

etymology.hint: Two people 从 together in a cart

currentComponents.note: 冂 (a covering or frame, here representing a cart) — 两 pictures two things sharing one enclosure.
从 (two people following each other) — together with the frame above, 两 shows a pair joined together, giving its meaning 'two' or 'both.'

dictionary.definition: to arrange; to execute on; to manage

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 措 describes arranging or handling something.
昔 (xī) gives a sound distantly related to cuò, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to grant, to bestow; to act; surname

usedInWords.meaning: (bound form) to put into effect (regulations etc)

currentComponents.note: 方 depicts a banner or flag mounted on a pole, once used to broadcast public orders — 施 relates to carrying out or bestowing something openly, as with an official proclamation.
也 (yě) supplies a sound related to shī, an early phonetic link that has drifted apart considerably over the centuries.

dictionary.definition: to take aim at; to look at

currentComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 瞄 is an action done with the eyes.
苗 (miáo) gives the sound — an exact match with 瞄.

dictionary.definition: the Tang dynasty; Chinese; empty, exaggerated; surname

etymology.hint: Children learning how to read 口 and write 肀 in school 广

currentComponents.note: 广 depicts a roofed building, a school or hall.
肀 depicts a hand holding a writing brush.
口 (mouth) — children reading aloud and writing in school gave 唐 its early meaning, later borrowed as the name of the Tang dynasty.

dictionary.definition: news, information; to question, to interrogate

currentComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 讯 relates to asking questions and gathering information through words.
卂 (xùn) is an exact match for the sound of 讯.

dictionary.definition: complete, extensive, full; to fill

currentComponents.note: Bow — original sense of a strung bow, later extended to 'full/filled.'
Gives the sound ěr, related to mí but drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to join, to connect; continuous; even

etymology.hint: A cart 车 moving 辶 goods between cities

currentComponents.note: 车 (cart) — the vehicle moving goods.
辶 (walking/movement) — the cart traveling along a road, linking one place to another, giving 连 its meaning 'to connect, link.'

dictionary.definition: Korea, especially South Korea; surname

usedInWords.meaning: Korea from the fall of the Joseon dynasty in 1897

currentComponents.note: 韦 originally depicted a well encircled by a fenced enclosure — 韩 named an ancient walled settlement, later a state name, and today the character used to write 'Korea.'
倝 (gàn), itself built from 日 (sun) and radiating lines, supplies an ancient sound echo for hán, an early phonetic link that has drifted considerably.

dictionary.definition: to wrap, to encircle; to confine, to bind

currentComponents.note: 衣 (clothes) — 裹 relates to wrapping something, like fabric around an object.
果 (guǒ) gives the sound — an exact match with 裹.

dictionary.definition: spring; source, root, head; surname

currentComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 源 originally referred to the spring where a river begins
原 (yuán) gives the sound — an exact match with 源's reading yuán

dictionary.definition: rug, carpet, blanket

currentComponents.note: 毛 (fur/hair) — 毯 names a woven covering made from fur or wool.
炎 (yán) gives a sound distantly related to tǎn, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to throw, to hurl, to cast away

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — throwing is an action done with the hand.
乃 (nǎi) gives a sound distantly related to rēng, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: bare, nude; to strip, to undress

currentComponents.note: 衤 (clothes) — 裸 describes the absence of clothing, being bare.
果 (guǒ) gives a sound close to luǒ, sharing the same rhyme.

dictionary.definition: trap, snare, pitfall

etymology.hint: A farm 阝 with a well 井; 井 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: On the left side, 阝 derives from 阜 (mound, earthworks), pointing to something dug into the ground.
井 means 'well' and is pronounced jǐng — the same as 阱 — evoking a deep pit dug into the earth like a well, which gave 阱 its meaning 'pitfall, trap.'

dictionary.definition: false, counterfeit, bogus

currentComponents.note: 亻 (person) shows 伪 describes something false or counterfeit, often about people's actions or claims.
为 (wéi) gives a sound very close to wěi, differing mainly in tone.

dictionary.definition: banquet, feast; to entertain

etymology.hint: A woman 女 cooking food 日 for a house 宀 banquet

currentComponents.note: 宀 (roof) marks the setting — a house or hall.
妟 (a woman 女 beneath the sun 日) suggests ease and comfort — people gathered comfortably under a roof, giving 宴 its meaning 'banquet, feast.'

dictionary.definition: palace; surname

currentComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 宫 names a palace, a grand building.
吕 (lǚ) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading gōng has diverged considerably.

dictionary.definition: to scatter, to disperse, to break up

etymology.hint: A hand 攵 tossing seeds from a basket

currentComponents.note: 散 traditionally depicts a hand (攵) scattering something, like seeds tossed from a basket — the image behind its meaning 'to scatter, disperse.'

dictionary.definition: adornment, make-up; to dress up, to use make-up

currentComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妆 describes putting on makeup, an action tied to appearance.
丬 gives a sound related to zhuāng, though the connection has drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: humble, low, inferior; to despise

etymology.hint: A hand 又(altered) holding an empty shell 甲 (altered)

currentComponents.note: 卑 traditionally pictures a hand holding an empty, lowly object — an old image behind its meaning 'low, humble.'

dictionary.definition: rustic, vulgar; to despise, to scorn

currentComponents.note: 阝 (village) — an older semantic link to a remote, rustic place, hence 鄙's sense of "low, base."
啚 (bǐ) gives the sound — an exact match with 鄙.

dictionary.definition: broad, spacious, vast, wide

currentComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 宽 originally described a spacious house.
苋 (xiàn) gives a sound distantly related to kuān, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to excuse, to forgive, to show mercy

currentComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恕 describes a heartfelt willingness to forgive.
如 (rú) gives a sound only distantly related to shù today, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: to change, to replace, to substitute for

etymology.hint: One man 夫 replacing another; 日 provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 夫 (man) is shown twice, side by side, one man standing in for another.
日 sits below, together giving 替 its meaning 'to replace, to substitute.'

dictionary.definition: fragile, frail; brittle, crisp

etymology.hint: Something dangerous 危 to one's flesh ⺼

currentComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh) — 脆 originally described flesh that tears or breaks easily.
危 (dangerous) contributes to the character's form, describing something fragile or easily broken.

dictionary.definition: weak, fragile, delicate

etymology.hint: Two shoots 弓 dying to frost 冫

currentComponents.note: 弓 here pictures a young, bent shoot rather than a bow.
冫 (ice/frost) repeated twice suggests two young shoots wilting in the cold, giving 弱 its meaning 'weak, fragile.'

dictionary.definition: tyrant; to usurp, to rule by might

currentComponents.note: Rain — an older semantic root kept from the character's older form.

dictionary.definition: warm, genial

currentComponents.note: Sun — warmth comes from the sun.
Gives the sound yuán, related to nuǎn but drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: gem, jewel, pearl, precious stone

currentComponents.note: 王 (jade, written as the radical for 玉) — 珠 names a round gem or bead.
朱 (zhū) is an exact match for the sound of 珠.

dictionary.definition: printing block, edition; register; volume, version

currentComponents.note: 片 (a slice/plate) — 版 originally referred to a wooden printing block
反 (fǎn) gives the sound — an exact match with 版's reading bǎn

dictionary.definition: rose

currentComponents.note: 王 (jade, written as 王 in components) — 玫 originally described a type of fine jade or gem.
攵 gives a sound only distantly related to méi today, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: extraordinary, fabulous; rose; semi-precious stone

currentComponents.note: 王 (jade) — 瑰 originally described a fine, precious stone.
鬼 (guǐ) gives a sound close to guī, differing only in tone.

dictionary.definition: high, dignified; to esteem, to honor

currentComponents.note: 山 (mountain) — 崇 describes something towering high, like a mountain, extending to 'to revere.'
宗 (zōng) shares the rhyme -ong with chóng, though the initial has drifted from z- to ch- over time.

dictionary.definition: to labor, to toil; to do manual work

etymology.hint: A man lifting 力 a load 冖 of grass 艹

currentComponents.note: 艹 (grass) — a bundle of grass or straw carried as a load
力 (strength) — the effort of lifting and carrying the heavy load

dictionary.definition: to move, to remove, to shift, to transfer

currentComponents.note: Hand — moving things is done by hand.
Gives the sound bān, matching the character's reading.

dictionary.definition: to lack, to be short; vacancy, gap, deficit

currentComponents.note: 缶 (a clay jar) — 缺 relates to something broken or missing, like a cracked vessel.
夬 (guài) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading quē has diverged.
